title: I am satisfied in your love

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: In You I’ve found my rest

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: You are the life I live

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Your love is perfect and everlasting
I am satisfied in Your love

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: My eyes have seen Your goodness
You are true to Your word

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Your grace You’ve lavished on me
You are true to Your word
